content.why_choose:
Pros of the NMIMS Online

  • Best University for online degree: NMIMS Online has received the Education Innovation Awards, Entrepreneur India (2022), for the best university offering an online degree.
  • NGA-SCE: The NMIMS Global Access School for Continuing Education has officially partnered with 50+ corporate MNCs and start-ups for NMIMS Online courses.
  • Program Customization: With NMIMS Online, students can customize their course with the specialization of their choice and pursue it at their own pace.
content.placement:
NMIMS Online courses are placement-assisted, and the placement cell remains active throughout the course duration to provide continuous guidance. NMIMS Online course graduates are entitled to a plethora of job opportunities with the 500+ hiring partners of the institution.

There are several career services available under the NMIMS Online Placement Cell, namely:

  • Assessment of cognitive abilities and skills.
  • Resume and CV development with social media profiling.
  • Guidance from NMIMS Online career coaches.
  • Interview preparation.
  • Access to job opportunities with a dedicated job portal.

NMIMS Online has collaborated with various MNCs, business organizations, and start-ups across several industries that actively recruit skilled professionals from the university. Some major recruiters of NMIMS Online graduates are:

  • Indiamart
  • Wockhardt
  • Zalaris
  • Milkbasket
  • Tata
  • Shopx
content.exam:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.
content.emi:
To lessen the financial burden on students and working professionals willing to acquire an online degree from NMIMS Online CDOE, the institute provides several financial assistance options, including loans, no-cost EMI, and scholarship facilities. The NMIMS online EMI assistance is available for a tenure of 3, 6, 9, or 12 months. The loan and EMI facility is available through the credit cards of the following banks:

  • HDFC Bank
  • ICICI Bank
  • Axis Bank
  • Citi Bank
  • Standard Chartered Bank
  • HSBC Bank
  • Kotak Mahindra Bank

A scholarship of 20% on the program fee is also available at the NMIMS Online CDOE for the armed forces, defence personnel, and their immediate family.
content.faculty_intro: To offer top-notch education assistance to students, the NMIMS Online has 140+ faculty members from IIMs/IITs and 90+ PhD scholars. That guides students throughout their academic careers and helps them develop their promising professional careers.
content.admission_steps:
Candidates who are interested in pursuing an online degree from NMIMS Online are required to first qualify for the eligibility criteria of their chosen program prior to beginning the following NMIMS online admission process:

  1. Step 1. Visit the official website of the university and register online at online.nmims.edu.
  2. Step 2. Fill out the NMIMS online application form with the required information.
  3. Step 3. Pay the mentioned NMIMS online application fee.
  4. Step 4. Submit the supporting documents along with the NMIMS online application form.
  5. Step 5. Pay the NIMIMS course fee via a demand draft in favour of "SVKM's NMIMS" payable at Mumbai.
  6. Step 6. Wait for confirmation from the university end. Once the application is confirmed, the university will generate a student number for you.

facts.fact_description: NMIMS online courses offer a rich and holistic learning experience with its virtual learning environment and on-campus immersion program & bootcamp.
The institution provides access to 1 Connect, a tool designed to assist students with personalized guidance and support by providing a timely resolution to their queries.
The career services provide a 6 month access to job portals like IIMJobs, Updazz, and Hirist.
NMIMS Online provides an online MBA and an online MBA (WX), which is an executive program designed primarily for working professionals (mid-senior professionals).
The NMIMS Online courses follow experimental learning with a plethora of specializations, real-world case studies, business simulation projects, and hands-on industry experiences.
The "Students Zone" of NMIMS Online can be accessed through a phone or a laptop, allowing students to study anytime, anywhere.

features.d: Plus lifetime access to all recordings on the LMS.
Learn from academics and industry practitioners.
Industry-mentored capstone to apply your skills.
Flexible fee plans starting from ₹8,334 per month.

financing.d: Flexible plans starting from ₹8,334 per month.
For armed forces personnel & their family.
